text:
Type: expandable sphere pendant lamp
Use: statement ambient light over a dining table or a sitting area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: white plastic panels on a white metal frame, turquoise inner panels, white cord and ceiling cup, pull cord
Colors: white, mint turquoise inside
Shape: round globe of interlocking curved panels that open and close with a pull cord, hangs on a thin cord, sculptural, medium size, light and open
Feel: playful, futuristic, airy, sculptural
Goes with: white walls, light wood, grey or pastel accents; modern, Scandinavian or contemporary rooms

product.name: IKEA PS 2014
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 600 lumen globe clear. View more product information You can easily switch between a brighter general light and a softer mood light by just pulling the strings.
